title: Ordinary exceptional-system site and compact-support interfaces
statement: For schemes X and Y, a morphism f and a compactification c [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], a commutative ring O and element t, use the ordinary strict coefficient-system derived images and evaluations [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison] and the strict etale interfaces [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. Define the pro-etale evaluation and inverse-image presentations; compact-support data consist of ordinary open extension, its geometric restriction adjunction, proper derived image, all level evaluations and localization factorizations, with the displayed ordinary and derived mate coherence. A system site comparison retains the ordinary etale/pro-etale image, its derived adjunction and its etale-origin full subcategory. Pullback squares and compactification comparisons retain their ordinary inverse-image squares, level comparisons, and adjunction mates. Their composites define exceptionalProSupport, the proper/open support comparison, its restriction to etale-origin objects, the transported right functor and its level comparisons. The origin adjunction interface records the actual Hom bijections with their unit/counit; scalar and transport interfaces retain the corresponding quotient-scalar and counit normalization equations. These are definitions of supplied data, without an existence assertion or a finite-base-field restriction.
